facts.en: Completed a certificate in Supply Chain Fundamentals at Fictional Institute D026 in 2025.
facts.zh: 2025 年在虚构院校 D026 完成供应链基础结业证书。

facts.en: Worked on a fixed-term dispatch support assignment at Fictional Depot D026 from 2026-01 to 2026-06.
facts.zh: 2026-01 至 2026-06 在虚构仓站 D026 从事定期发运支持工作。

facts.en: Printed dispatch labels and compared package counts with approved pick lists before supervisor sign-off.
facts.zh: 打印发运标签，在主管签字前将包裹数量与获批拣货单核对。

facts.en: Recorded carrier collection times and unresolved count discrepancies in a shared spreadsheet.
facts.zh: 在共享电子表格记录承运商取货时间和未解决的数量差异。

facts.en: Prepared a desk guide explaining where to find carrier cutoff times; a senior clerk approved it.
facts.zh: 编写说明承运商截单时间查询位置的桌面指南，由高级文员批准。

facts.en: Escalated late collections by telephone using the team contact list; did not negotiate carrier contracts.
facts.zh: 使用团队联系人清单，通过电话上报取货延误；未谈判承运商合同。

facts.en: No measured throughput improvement was recorded during the assignment.
facts.zh: 该工作期间未记录可量化的吞吐量改善。

facts.en: No dangerous-goods certification or forklift qualification is held.
facts.zh: 未持有危险品认证或叉车操作资格。
